subject: Variant consolidation - exception request & comms
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal - Acme <legal@acme.com>, Acme DevOps <devops@acme.com>
Date: 2027-08-04 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Variant consolidation: compatibility impact on Acme integration

Hi Sofia,

Quick note from our engineering team: after running the latest compatibility sweep against the model family you announced for consolidation, we found a set of prompts that break the contract we rely on (structured JSON output and a field rename: "user_payload" -> "payload_body"). This affects two production endpoints behind a critical workflow.

Attached is a condensed compatibility matrix (acme_compat_matrix_v1.csv) showing failing prompts and the delta in tokens/keys. Our questions:
- Can Acme get an exception to keep the older variant for 60–90 days while we update callers?
- What exact timeline are you planning for routing the hosted traffic away from the legacy variant?
- Any temporary mitigation you can provide (pinning, aliasing, or a compatibility shim)?

We’re sensitive to SLA and audit timelines — legal is CC'd for contract implications. We can join a 30-minute sync today if that helps.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Head of Integrations, Acme Corp

Attachment: acme_compat_matrix_v1.csv (CSV, 32 KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-04 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Variant consolidation: compatibility impact on Acme integration

Jane — thanks for the matrix and the clear examples. Sorry for the disruption. I’ve looped in Product (Marissa) and Customer Ops (Ben) so we can coordinate a fast option.

Two quick clarifying asks before we propose terms:
1) Which endpoints (full path and route) are returning the field rename? list the routes and example IDs if possible.
2) Do you have traffic volume for the affected calls (rps/p50 latency) so we can size the canary?

Immediate short-term options we can offer today:
- Pinning: we can pin your account to the legacy variant for a limited time.
- Compatibility shim: ops can route a lightweight transform on responses for known keys (minor token cost).

I’m attaching a mutual action plan template to capture milestones if we go the exception route. Can you confirm whether Acme needs the variant to remain exactly same behavior (no latency change) or if a staged degradation is acceptable?

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync at 16:00 PT today to align on volume and timeline. If that works, Ben will send the invite and pre-call checklist.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_TEMPLATE.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-05 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Variant consolidation: exception request & comms

Team — reviewed Acme's matrix and internal perf traces. TL;DR: we can support a scoped exception with conditions. Proposed terms below for internal alignment before we send to Acme: 

1) Exception length: 90 days from approval.
2) Conditions: Acme provides a test matrix (same format as attached) and completes a canary in our staging environment within 10 business days.
3) Operational limits: We’ll cap pinned traffic to 30% of baseline throughput for the exception period; if more capacity is needed, they must move to a Dedicated plan.
4) Observability: We'll require request-level logs for failing prompts for the duration (redacted as needed) to speed triage.
5) Legal: amendment signed via DocuSign to reflect temporary SLA/retention terms.

I’ve drafted exception_terms.pdf (summary) and will send to Legal for a quick review. Ben — please lead the CS cadence and draft the customer-facing comms. Naomi — please scope any infra cost delta and put an estimate in HubSpot. Rishi — coordinate rollback/rollback-hatch runbook with runtime.

If everyone is aligned, I’ll create the DocuSign envelope and route to Acme legal.

Marissa
VP Product, Redwood Inference

Attachment: exception_terms.pdf
Related link: DocuSign:DS-892374

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-06 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Variant consolidation: exception request & comms

Jane — thanks for taking the call yesterday. Per Marissa's direction, here’s the customer plan:

1) We’ll provision a 90-day exception (conditional) once we receive the signed amendment. Look for a DocuSign link from Legal by EOD.
2) Next steps we need from Acme by EOD Friday (2027-08-13):
   - Completed compatibility test matrix (use the attached template)
   - Traffic volumes for the affected endpoints (rps, daily calls)
   - Point of contact for staging canary (engineer + SSO access details)
3) We’ll schedule a staging canary for week of 2027-08-16; ops will monitor for regressions and token-cost delta.

Temporary mitigations we’re enabling immediately: pinning to legacy variant for Acme org, capped at 30% traffic; and a response key-mapping shim for the top three failing prompts to keep upstream callers unbroken. These are short-term and intended to give Acme runway.

Can we lock a 30-minute canary kickoff on Monday 2027-08-16 at 10:00 PT? If that works, reply-all and I’ll send the invite and pre-call checklist.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Customer Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Quoted: "On 2027-08-05 15:20, Marissa Cole wrote: Team — reviewed Acme's matrix and internal perf traces..."
